# c8volt v5

Independent Camunda operations CLI for DevOps teams. Documentation targets
Camunda 8.10; 8.9 and 8.8 remain supported. Version-specific features are marked
"only c8.10+". Not an official Camunda product.

Inspect state, analyse slow instances, repair incidents, deploy BPMN, and clean
up runtime data and history. Preview mutations with --dry-run where supported.

Flag grammar: bare properties select; --set-* writes; --with-* adds detail.
--retries selects jobs; --set-retries writes retries. --timeout controls HTTP;
update job --set-timeout changes the job timeout. No aliases for renamed flags in v5.

Use c8volt capabilities --json for command support, flags, and output modes.

- Quick start: https://c8volt.info/#fast-start
- Configuration: https://c8volt.info/configuration/
- Ops playbooks: https://c8volt.info/ops/
- CLI reference: https://c8volt.info/cli/
- Command tree: https://c8volt.info/cli/command-tree/
- Tool context: https://c8volt.info/ai-search-context/
- Repository: https://github.com/grafvonb/c8volt
- Releases: https://github.com/grafvonb/c8volt/releases
